notes: long format; native observation frequency; revisions are append-only
This is a proposed contract. Bind to current repository conventions, do not create duplicate authority.

required_fields.entity_id: e.g. NIKKEI225 or normalized security ID; never mix index/ETF
required_fields.observation_date: YYYY-MM-DD in the declared source calendar
required_fields.value: finite number or null with status
required_fields.is_imputed: boolean; imputed rows cannot prove raw coverage
required_fields.published_at: ISO8601 offset datetime or null; proven release only
required_fields.available_at_estimate: ISO8601 offset datetime or null; not claimed as observed release time
required_fields.precision_note: raw precision / rounded ratio / EPS derived estimate
required_fields.dependencies: IDs+hashes of parents for derived data

feature_rules.asof: only available evidence <= explicit information_cutoff; unknown must not silently become known
feature_rules.weekly_to_daily: as-of carry only after publication; retain original observation age
feature_rules.vintage: select latest revision known as-of, not final revision known now
feature_rules.close_vs_ohlc: close-only data does not satisfy OHLC features
feature_rules.future_outcomes: labels kept separate; never part of search features
feature_rules.no_guarantees: complete original PIT must be proved separately from current revised-history coverage
